description: Price segment in force on a date for every recorded Gemini 4 model, or for one model: input and output USD per 1,000,000 tokens, the segment start and end dates and its status. Segments marked announced-unpriced have no published values and are reported as such.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) that selects the price segment in force that day. Defaults to today (UTC).

modelId.description: Restrict the answer to one model. Omit for all recorded models.

name: get_gemini_pricing
title: Get Gemini 4 list prices for a date
